plan.designEvidence: Local contrast and amplitude checks on the five known E2/E3/B3 recordings informed the design. They are development controls, not held-out evidence.
plan.selection: Highest pooled development onset F1 among nonzero candidates; tie prefers lower strength. Baseline remains the acceptance reference even if all candidates lose. Freeze before fresh evaluation.
plan.notes: Invoke only when strength*projection can reach the activity threshold and exceed the existing weight. Positive support floor strength * original harmonic projection * local peak prominence, after greedy pursuit. No whitening. Peak +/-1 bin, log-parabolic tuning check +/-0.5 semitone; background median offsets +/-3..7 bins; amplitude 4*peak/N compared with raw RMS. No support if a parent-selected lower pitch can explain the peak as partial 2..12. All pitches use the same rule. No veto on missing fundamentals; no automatic removal of upper pitches. Other F-003 timing, scorer and gates fixed. Fresh v6 public cases and seeded broadband-noise controls.
